name: Habit Building
description: Plan small, specific steps that fit into your day and track them lightly. It is a planning approach, not a guarantee of results.

steps.text: Pick one habit and describe it as a single small action you can do today.
Choose a cue that already happens each day, such as after a morning drink.
Make the first version so easy that it feels almost too small.
Note whether you did it, without judging the day.
If you miss a day, plan the next step rather than restarting the whole plan.

claims.text: Small, specific actions may be easier to repeat than large goals.
Attaching a new action to a routine you already have may make it easier to remember.
A very easy first version can lower the effort needed to begin.
Simple yes or no notes can show progress without adding pressure.
Planning the next step after a missed day may feel less discouraging than starting over.

safety_notes: Not medical advice. Habit plans do not replace advice from a clinician.
Do not push through pain, exhaustion or health warning signs to keep a habit going.
Choose habits that fit your health, time and budget.
